what: A grayscale filter layer (backdrop-filter grayscale 1) covers the photo cell, then lifts with power2.out (scrub .8) as the cell’s top edge rises on screen from 35% → 5%, so the photo color returns — scrolling down the list, each row takes on color in turn.

options.toggle: When ‹true›, instead of scrub it clears over dur seconds as it passes the start position (default 50% bottom — when half the cell touches the bottom of the screen), and covers again in reverse when scrolled back above that position. Default curve power1.out
options.once: If ”true”, once it lifts via toggle it does not cover again when scrolled back (original ScrollMagic reverse: false)

from.where: index.html .st-ctrl__img (black-and-white veil over the photo in a process list row)

shared.js .db-gs (concept · service card · price · news · recruit photos) — original grayscale tween: when half of the cell reaches the bottom of the screen it turns to color over 1s power1.out, and reverses when scrolling back

shared.css [data-rv=color] — original .Js-scroll.color: the photo starts at grayscale(100%), and when a ScrollMagic scene (triggerHook onEnter · offset 200 · reverse false) adds is-fire, the filter goes to none over .35s ease. In the first-page feature strip, cells past the center get watched (same .35s)
from.options: toggle: true; once: true; start: top bottom-=200; dur: .35; ease: 0.25,0.1,0.25,1

note: Attached by the curtain part at the very end of the cell <i class="fx-gray-veil"> Applied as grayscale. Other layers in the cell (above z-index 5) get no grayscale
